title: HtmlTr
responsibility: Renders the native tr element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTr.attributes
inputs.description: Native tr attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTr.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native tr element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTr
outputs.description: The actual native tr element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
